sig: [[["A", "Hi Laura. I'm putting together the interview panel for the senior developer role. Have you got a moment?"], ["B", "Sure, Greg. Who's on it so far?"], ["A", "Me, Hannah from the architecture team, and I'd like you to join as well."], ["B", "Happy to. When are the interviews?"], ["A", "We've got three candidates. I was thinking Tuesday the eighth, all afternoon."], ["B", "Ah, I've got a client workshop that day. Could we do Wednesday the ninth instead?"], ["A", "Let me check Hannah's calendar. She's free on the ninth, but only until three."], ["B", "So if each interview's an hour, we'd need to start at noon."], ["A", "That works. I'll book a room and send invites to the candidates today."], ["B", "Great. Could you also forward me their CVs? I'd like to prepare some technical questions."], ["A", "Will do. I'll send them over by the end of the day."]], {"A": "M-GB", "B": "F-US"}]
